explainBack.prompt: Why can a Data agent dashboard be confidently wrong even when the account's permissions all worked exactly as configured?
explainBack.response: Permissions only control which tables, rows and columns the connected account may read. They cannot tell you whether the connected source contains all the relevant records, whether the metric definition the agent applied matches the decision you are making, or whether the agent's explanation of the number is correct. So a dashboard can be perfectly permitted and still count the wrong thing — one team's 'active customers' may mean weekly logins while yours means monthly purchases.
explainBack.expectedEvidence: The answer should use the article's causal chain: permissions gate access (P007), definitions decide what a number includes (P007), and P008's explicit limit that permissions do not prove completeness, fit or correctness.
explainBack.assessment: The article's mechanism fully supports this answer in ordinary language; P007 and P008 supply every causal step without gaps.

unseenTransfer.prompt: Using the article's mechanism, how should the HR lead decide which number to trust before the slide goes out?
unseenTransfer.response: Walk the chain: (1) Source — is only the new applicant-tracking system connected, while older roles live in the legacy system the recruiting report includes? (2) Definition — does the agent count posting-to-offer while the team counts posting-to-start-date? (3) Permission — can the connected account see all departments' hiring records, or only some rows? Then apply P009: name the source and date, state the definition used, compare the figure with the trusted report, and because the totals differ, stop and investigate before sharing.
unseenTransfer.expectedEvidence: Correct application requires the source-definition-permission chain from P007–P008 and the stop-if-totals-differ rule from P009, with no invented product capabilities.
unseenTransfer.assessment: The mechanism transfers cleanly to this unseen HR scenario; every diagnostic step follows from the article without additional assumptions, confirming genuine transfer value.

incidentExplained.observation: The release, what the agent does, who configures it, and the accuracy evidence gap form an understandable causal sequence.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: OpenAI released a Data agent in ChatGPT Work on September 10. It is a workplace data tool that can connect an approved account to company data, investigate a question and build a dashboard. A colleague can ask why sales slowed without first writing a database query.
The plugin is available through ChatGPT Work. Administrators install it, connect its data sources and decide who may use them. OpenAI announced no standalone plugin price.

The largest evidence gap is accuracy. VentureBeat asked OpenAI for a retrieval or correctness benchmark for the external product and reported that none has been published. OpenAI described an internal comparison with its own data tools but supplied no public number. There is no independent hands-on benchmark yet showing how reliably it answers questions across customers' systems.

termsExplainedInContext.observation: Permission and metric definition are defined in plain language at first meaningful use inside the explanation.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: The agent can only work with the sources its administrators connect and the records its account is already allowed to see. A permission means which tables, rows and columns the connected account is allowed to see. A metric definition is the rule a company uses to decide what a number includes.

readerConsequenceSpecific.observation: The consequence is grounded in a specific situation: sharing a polished dashboard whose totals differ from the trusted report.

artifactEvidence.excerpt: Imagine asking for active customers. One team may count anyone who logged in this week; another may count people who bought something this month. Both dashboards can look polished and still answer different questions. Permissions limit access; they do not prove the source is complete, the definition fits this decision or the explanation is correct.

Before sharing a Data agent result, open the evidence behind its findings. Name the source and date, state the metric definition, and compare one important figure with the trusted report your team already uses. If the totals differ, stop there and investigate.

OpenAI's controls separate who can use a plugin, which read or write actions it may take and when ChatGPT asks for approval. For an early test, let the agent prepare the dashboard while sending messages or changing records still requires a person.
OpenAI says business-product data is not used to train its models by default. Check your organization's account, retention rules, permissions and workplace policy before adding sensitive data.
